rows.grounds: Sequential expression indicating what follows the preceding acts.
Agent qualified to perform the recitation; compound of mantra and knower.
Object of recitation, a thousand repetitions associated with Gajāntaka.

items.question: What recitation must the mantra-knower perform after the preceding visualization and mantra repetition?
premises: The preceding instructions prescribe closing the eyes, visualizing the goddess, and repeating the mantra.
The expression tataḥ paraṃ indicates a subsequent ritual action.
The mantra-knower is specified as the agent of this subsequent action.
items.inference: After completing the prior visualization and mantra repetition, the mantra-knower must recite the Gajāntaka thousandfold.
uncertainties: The exact identity or form of the Gajāntaka mantra or name is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Then, after that, the one who knows the mantras should recite the Gajāntaka a thousand times.
